definitions.explanation: All aspects or parts of something; the general or comprehensive scope.

examples.japanese: {経済|けいざい}{全般|ぜんぱん}に{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える。
examples.english: It affects the economy as a whole.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}{全般|ぜんぱん}について{話|はな}し{合|あ}った。
examples.english: We discussed work matters in general.

examples.japanese: {全般|ぜんぱん}{的|てき}に{良|よ}い{結果|けっか}だった。
examples.english: Overall, it was a good result.
examples.notes: 全般的に = overall, in general

notes:
{全般|ぜんぱん} means the entirety or overall scope of something. It's used to discuss things comprehensively rather than specifically.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜{全般|ぜんぱん}: ~ in general, ~ as a whole
- {全般|ぜんぱん}{的|てき}（に）: overall, in general

EXAMPLES OF USE:
- {経済|けいざい}{全般|ぜんぱん}: the economy as a whole
- {健康|けんこう}{全般|ぜんぱん}: overall health
- {業務|ぎょうむ}{全般|ぜんぱん}: business operations in general

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {全体|ぜんたい}: whole, entire (more concrete)
- {一般|いっぱん}: general, common
- {総合|そうごう}: comprehensive, overall
